title: BMW BERLIN-MARATHON 2026 Race Briefing (English PDF)
claims: The 2026 event is the 52nd BMW BERLIN-MARATHON and takes place on Sunday 27 September 2026.
The start is on Straße des 17. Juni and the finish is behind the Brandenburg Gate.
The run starts from 8:45 am in six waves.
The public transport ticket included with the start card is valid from 24 September (midnight) to 28 September (3 am) in fare zone ABC.
Hydration systems with a maximum total volume of 3 litres are permitted, and refills are available at all refreshment and food stations.

Own refreshments can be delivered to km 5, 9, 15, 20, 25, 30, 36 and 40; drop-off is from 6:30 to 7:30 am at Annemarie-Renger-Straße on the corner of Otto-von-Bismarck-Allee, and glass containers are not permitted.
The MARATHON EXPO by BRITA is at Flughafen Tempelhof, Platz der Luftbrücke 5, reachable by U6 to Platz der Luftbrücke plus about a 10-minute walk, or by bus M43 or 248.
The briefing says there is no parking at the expo and visitors should use public transport.
The briefing says medical teams, cycle doctors, medical aid organisations and Berlin Fire Brigade patrols are present in the start/finish area and along the route.
